body: Envelope implementer handoff note, no request to edit before your child/path gate. Please make the spec distinguish normative public type names from illustrative wire examples, and state ownership for each root: acquire invocation/result account, view projection/report outcomes and ViewBasis, codec encoders, and manifest artifact roles. I will need exact smart-constructor laws for Established versus Unestablished, semantic/report/invocation separation, per-requested-layer accounting, and provenance-derived basis; unknown/future claim families must use a typed extension boundary rather than generic CandidateLedger[A] JSON. Please also surface the unresolved codec -> view dependency ruling as an explicit chief/ADR gate. I will not start implementation until cand-70 lands and your authorized spec is frozen, and I am not claiming reviewer status.
